body.name: Exact support and separator verifier
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Verify}(I,\Gamma)\) parses canonical records; recomputes \(b_c\), \(\mathcal E\), \(\mathcal H\), and contracted bags; classifies every support \(S\subseteq H\) by exact rational rank, consistency, and nonnegativity; compares the resulting canonical list with \(\mathcal V_H\); recomputes every lower and upper separator-table row by finite min-sum or max-sum recurrence; follows backpointers; and accepts exactly when both reconstructed original mass vectors satisfy all raw equalities and evaluate under \(g\) to the claimed endpoints.
